complete_optimistic_budget: All valid words require two calls per each of five sources and31 outputs. A12-source-event universal path repeating the cheapest B yields base+2 min B. falsification: Any discarded path or >10source schedule beating the proposed bound at a positive price, a missed >4readout mask, or dirty-source/connector/target endpoint mismatch invalidates it.
